michelle: Quick Q — I’m planning to start parental leave in June but my partner needs to relocate to Germany for work. Do we pro-rate leave or change payroll since I’ll be on a short-term international transfer?
jamal (People Ops): Congrats! :party_parrot: For leave itself, Redwood’s parental leave is based on employment status not location. You’ll still get the same entitlement.
ashley (Payroll): There are 2 payroll bits: tax withholding and benefits deductions. If your payroll country changes we need a payroll transfer request 30 days before the move. Otherwise we continue current payroll and handle travel reimbursements separately.
michelle: Thanks — partner’s visa timeline might slip a handful of weeks. If I’m delayed returning to the US, can I extend leave or take unpaid extension?
ryan (Benefits): Yes — you can request a leave extension (paid if coverage exists, otherwise unpaid). Please fill the `Parental Leave Amendment` form and we’ll route to your manager + HRBP.
michelle: Where’s the form? I can’t find it in the handbook.
people-ops-bot: Quick link: https://intranet.redwood/team/people-ops/leave-forms (Parental Leave Request, Amendment, Return-to-Work plan)
jamal (People Ops): Also, if partner’s visa requires job-search/travel documentation, we can provide an employment verification letter. Slack me and I’ll draft it with the dates you want.
michelle: Awesome. For payroll transfer — what documents will payroll need from me?
ashley (Payroll): Minimal list: passport copy, proof of German address, local tax id (if issued), and signed payroll transfer form. If you don’t have tax id yet we can start with a temporary setup (withholding adjustments later).
michelle: Is there an impact on benefits like 401k or health plan if I’m briefly abroad?
ryan (Benefits): Health plan continues if you remain an employee on Redwood payroll. 401k contributions pause only if you go unpaid or become contractor. We’ll run the scenarios once you upload dates.
michelle: Cool. One last: I’m scheduled to return and pick up equipment from office on day 1 — if partner’s arrival is delayed, can we arrange shipping of my laptop back instead of office dropoff?
jamal (People Ops): Yes, we can coordinate a pickup/ship. Please include shipping address on the Return-to-Work plan and tag @ashley for cost center approval.
michelle: Perfect. I’ll fill the Amendment + Return-to-Work this afternoon and ping you both. Thanks! :heart:
ashley (Payroll): Happy to help — ping here with the documents and we’ll start the transfer workflow.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: if no amendment form submitted in 7 days, we’ll follow up automatically.
